snapshot.title: Loan system for bankruptcy protection
snapshot.description: Low-interest loan system prevents softlock when player runs out of Francs. Auto-repaid from next mission payout.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Loan available when Francs < cost of cheapest available rocket
Loan amount covers one basic mission
Very low interest rate (TBD in balance pass)
Loan auto-repaid from next mission payout
UI shows outstanding loan balance prominently
Player cannot take a second loan while one is outstanding
